destination.description: Destination directory relative to workspace root (e.g., 'libs/utils')

newName.description: New name for the project's directory. Defaults to the current directory name.

projectName.description: The project's new name, when the names are updated. Defaults to the directory's name.

packageName.description: The package's new name, when the names are updated. Defaults to the directory's name under the package's current scope.

updateName.description: Update the project name and the package name to follow the new location
